page.title: Desktop & Mobile Friendly
page.body:
Desktop & Mobile Friendly


PropertyList.es is designed to be easy to use, regardless of your experience level or technical expertise. With its intuitive interface and comprehensive features, PropertyList.es can help you streamline your workflow and maximize your productivity.


No installation required

PropertyList.es is a cloud-based platform, so there is no need to install any software on your computer or mobile device. Simply create an account and you can start using PropertyList right away.


Mobile-optimised

PropertyList’s responsive design makes it easy to use on any device, including your smartphone or tablet. You can access your listings, manage your leads, and generate reports from anywhere.


Easy to use interface 

PropertyList.es has a user-friendly interface that makes it easy to navigate and find the information you need so you can quickly get up to speed on using PropertyList.es

Powered by the latest technology 

PropertyList.es is built using the most up-to-date technologies, including the latest versions of Python, Ruby on Rails, and modern web frameworks. This ensures a fast, secure, and reliable experience so you can focus on your business without worrying about technical issues.
